name: Treeshaker Chimera
oracle_text:
All creatures able to block this creature do so.
When this creature dies, draw three cards.
blocked_sentences: All creatures able to block this creature do so.

needs.what: a continuous static block requirement on the source attacker (509.1c, Lure): every creature (optionally narrowed by a `blockers` filter) that is able to block this creature must block it, read live at each declare-blockers step whenever this creature is attacking, however it came to be attacking
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `must_block` is a one-shot op naming an attacker, so it needs a trigger and an `attacks` trigger would miss a creature put onto the battlefield attacking and use the stack; the `blocks_if_able` static compels a block of ANY attacker, not this one; `block_restriction` (with `require_all`) restricts who MAY block rather than requiring blocks
